ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) ROKRAT cloud-API C2 — non-browser egress to pCloud / Dropbox / Yandex / Box
ucs.description: Hunts ROKRAT / Dolphin / BLUELIGHT C2 and exfiltration where ScarCruft tunnels command-and-control and stolen documents through legitimate consumer cloud-storage APIs. Catches the highly characteristic ScarCruft pattern of a non-browser, non-native-sync process talking directly to api.pcloud.com / content.dropboxapi.com / cloud-api.yandex.net / api.box.com.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where (All_Traffic.dest_domain IN ("api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","downloader.disk.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com") OR All_Traffic.url IN ("*api.pcloud.com*","*content.dropboxapi.com*","*cloud-api.yandex.net*","*api.box.com*")) AND NOT (All_Traffic.process_name IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","Dropbox.exe","DropboxUpdate.exe","Yandex.Disk.exe","Box.exe","BoxDrive.exe","OneDrive.exe","explorer.exe")) by host All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.user All_Traffic.process_name All_Traffic.process_path All_Traffic.dest All_Traffic.dest_domain All_Traffic.dest_port | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Traffic)` | rename process_name as initiating_process, dest_domain as remote_domain | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — ROKRAT family C2 over legitimate cloud-storage APIs
let CloudApiHosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","downloader.disk.yandex.ru","webdav.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com"]);
let KnownClients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","safari.exe","dropbox.exe","dropboxupdate.exe","yandex.disk.exe","yandexdisk.exe","box.exe","boxdrive.exe","onedrive.exe","explorer.exe"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where (RemoteUrl has_any (CloudApiHosts))
     or (RemoteUrl matches regex @"(?i)(^|\.)(pcloud|dropboxapi|cloud-api\.yandex|box)\.(com|net|ru)$")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (KnownClients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend DropPath = tolower(InitiatingProcessFolderPath)
| extend Suspicious = DropPath has_any ("\\appdata\\local\\temp\\","\\appdata\\roaming\\","\\users\\public\\","\\programdata\\","\\downloads\\")
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp), Hits = count(),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine), SampleHash = any(InitiatingProcessSHA256)
          by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName,
             InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteUrl, Suspicious
| order by Suspicious desc, FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — ROKRAT C2 to consumer cloud-storage APIs (ASIM network telemetry)
let CloudApiHosts = dynamic(["api.pcloud.com","eapi.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","downloader.disk.yandex.ru","webdav.yandex.ru","api.box.com","upload.box.com"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where (HttpHostName has_any (CloudApiHosts))
     or (Url matches regex @"(?i)//(api|eapi|content|upload|cloud-api|downloader|webdav)\.(pcloud|dropboxapi|yandex|box)\.(com|net|ru)/")
| where isnotempty(SrcHostname)
| where not(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent has_any ("Dropbox","YandexDisk","Box ","OneDrive","Mozilla/5.0")) or HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent matches regex @"(?i)(python|powershell|winhttp|wininet|libcurl|go-http|okhttp)"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated), Hits = count(),
            UA = any(HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent), SampleUrl = any(Url)
          by SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, HttpHostName, DstIpAddr
| order by FirstSeen desc

#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(^|\.)(pcloud|dropboxapi|cloud-api\.yandex|disk\.yandex|box)\.(com|net|ru)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|opera|iexplore|safari|Dropbox|DropboxUpdate|Yandex\.Disk|YandexDisk|Box|BoxDrive|OneDrive|explorer)\.exe$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=NetworkConnectIP4 RemotePort=443}, field=[aid, ContextProcessId], include=[RemoteAddressIP4, RemotePort])

ucs.rationale: ScarCruft / APT37 has built a multi-year-stable family of implants (ROKRAT, CloudMensis, Dolphin, BLUELIGHT, GOLDBACKDOOR) that uniquely abuse pCloud, Dropbox, Yandex Disk and Box REST endpoints as their primary C2 and exfil channel — documented by Talos, Kaspersky, ESET and Volexity. Browsers and the official sync clients connect to *sync* hostnames; the API hostnames in this rule (api./content./

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft / Reaper / InkySquid) double-extension LNK lure spawning PowerShell / mshta carving an embedded payload
ucs.description: Hunts ScarCruft's signature LNK-based initial access where a weaponised .lnk (often masquerading as .pdf.lnk / .hwp.lnk / .docx.lnk targeting Korean-affairs themes) launched from Explorer spawns PowerShell, mshta, or a script host whose command line carves an embedded payload out of the LNK itself via Get-Content / ReadAllBytes / FromBase64String / Substring. This is the delivery chain observed in 2022–2024 ROKRAT / GOLDBACKDOOR / Chinotto campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="explorer.exe" AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(process,"(?i)\.lnk") OR match(process,"(?i)(FromBase64String|-EncodedCommand|-enc\s|Get-Content|\[System\.IO\.File\]|\[Convert\]::|ReadAllBytes|StreamReader|::Substring|Add-MpPreference)") | where match(process,"(?i)(Users\\\\[^\\\\]+\\\\(Downloads|Desktop|Documents)|\\\\Temp\\\\|\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp|\\\\Public\\\\)") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — LNK lure → script-host carving embedded payload from %TEMP%/Downloads
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "explorer.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","cmd.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where Cmd matches regex @"\.lnk\b"
     or Cmd has_any ("frombase64string","-encodedcommand","-enc "," -ec ","get-content","[system.io.file]","[convert]::","readallbytes","streamreader","::substring","add-mppreference","set-mppreference")
| where Cmd matches regex @"(?i)(users\\[^\\]+\\(downloads|desktop|documents)|\\temp\\|\\appdata\\local\\temp|\\public\\|\\programdata\\)"
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName endswith ".lnk"
    | where FolderPath matches regex @"(?i)(users\\[^\\]+\\(downloads|desktop|documents)|\\temp\\|\\appdata\\local\\temp|\\public\\)"
    | where FileSize > 500000     // ScarCruft LNK lures embed multi-MB payloads — pure shortcuts are <2KB
    | project DeviceId, LnkPath = FolderPath, LnkName = FileName, LnkSize = FileSize, LnkSeen = Timestamp
) on DeviceId
| where isnull(LnkSeen) or (Timestamp between (LnkSeen .. LnkSeen + 10m))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          Child = FolderPath, ChildName = FileName,
          CmdLine = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, LnkName, LnkPath, LnkSize
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT37 / ScarCruft — LNK lure (explorer-spawned) script-host carving embedded payload
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\explorer.exe"
| where NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\pwsh.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\mshta.exe"     or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\wscript.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\cscript.exe"   or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\cmd.exe"
     or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\rundll32.exe"  or NewProcessName endswith_cs "\\regsvr32.exe"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| where Cmd matches regex @"\.lnk\b"
     or Cmd has_any ("frombase64string","-encodedcommand","-enc "," -ec ","get-content","[system.io.file]","[convert]::","readallbytes","streamreader","::substring")
| where Cmd matches regex @"(?i)(users\\[^\\]+\\(downloads|desktop|documents)|\\temp\\|\\appdata\\local\\temp|\\public\\|\\programdata\\)"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 ScarCruft LNK Lure Carving Embedded Payload
id: e6a5c4b9-3d71-4f4e-8aa7-4b8a23cd7f51
status: experimental
description: Detects ScarCruft / APT37 LNK-based delivery where Explorer launches a script host that reads the LNK and carves an embedded payload from %TEMP% / Downloads / Public.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/rokrat-analysis/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/apt37-overview
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/05
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0067
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  child_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
  carve_signals:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.lnk'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-EncodedCommand'
      - 'Get-Content'
      - '[System.IO.File]'
      - '[Convert]::'
      - 'ReadAllBytes'
      - 'StreamReader'
      - '::Substring'
  staging_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\Desktop\'
      - '\AppData\Local\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
  condition: parent and child_image and carve_signals and staging_path
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate admin scripts launched from Explorer that read LNK metadata (rare)
  - Software installers that briefly read shortcuts under user staging folders
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\explorer.exe OR *\\Explorer.exe OR *\\EXPLORER.EXE) AND @Image:(*\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\WSCRIPT.EXE OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\cmd.exe OR *\\Cmd.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RunDLL32.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*.lnk* OR *FromBase64String* OR *-EncodedCommand* OR *-enc\ * OR *Get-Content* OR *ReadAllBytes* OR *System.IO.File* OR *Convert\]::* OR *::Substring* OR *StreamReader*) AND @CommandLine:(*\\Downloads\\* OR *\\Desktop\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Temp\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^explorer\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|mshta|wscript|cscript|cmd|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(\\.lnk\\b|FromBase64String|-EncodedCommand|-enc\\s|Get-Content|System\\.IO\\.File|Convert\\]::|ReadAllBytes|StreamReader|::Substring)", field=CommandLine)
